name: Tract Analysis Profiles (NODDI)
summary: Computes tract profiles of NODDI measures (NDI, ISOVF, ODI) along segmented white matter tracts with Vistasoft, producing profile plots and a tractmeasures CSV.
description: Samples NODDI measures (NDI, ISOVF, ODI) along each tract of a white matter classification (wmc) at numnodes evenly spaced nodes, weighting streamlines by their distance from the tract core (Vistasoft dtiComputeDiffusionPropertiesAlongFG) or, when fiberbased is true, without weighting (Compute_FA_AlongFG). Produces PNG/EPS profile plots per tract and measure and a tractmeasures CSV with means and standard deviations. Use it after tract segmentation; it needs the wmc and the whole-brain tck it was derived from.

inputs.description: The path to the wmc classification structure
The path to the NODDI datatype files
The tractogram (tck) corresponding to the wmc structure
inputs.requirements: Must be the whole-brain tractogram used to generate the wmc classification.

outputs.description: Directory of tract profile images for each tract and measure
CSV with all tracts and measures

parameters.description: to create profiles using a non-weighted, fiber-based method: "true"
Number of nodes for the tract profiles

citations.text: Yeatman JD, Dougherty RF, Myall NJ, Wandell BA, Feldman HM (2012) Tract Profiles of White Matter Properties: Automating Fiber-Tract Quantification. PLoS ONE 7(11): e49790.

failure_modes.cause: The number of profile images differs from the number expected (numfiles.txt).
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for tracts with too few streamlines or missing measure files.
